title: Hunter × Hunter
source: Hunter × Hunter manga by Yoshihiro Togashi (ongoing, often on hiatus). Meruem ends at the Chimera Ant arc; Killua uses the latest arc he appears in.
world: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, a licensed adventurer, to find his father Ging, and befriends Killua Zoldyck, heir of a family of assassins. Their adventures cross the Hunter Exam, Heavens Arena, Greed Island and the deadly Chimera Ant invasion led by the Ant King Meruem. After the Election arc, Killua travels with his sister Alluka. Inventive battles and morally grey characters.
power_system: Nen is the use of one's life energy (aura). Every user has one of six types: Enhancement, Transmutation, Emission, Conjuration, Manipulation or Specialization. Conditions and vows make Nen abilities stronger. Killua transmutes aura into electricity (Godspeed).
